reuse.why: Factors holiday matching into a shared isHoliday used by isNonWorkingDay and both server schedule sites, though those sites still recompose 'isWeekend || isHoliday' instead of sharing isNonWorkingDay.

duplication.why: The three inline holidays.includes checks collapse into one function; the pre-existing weekend-or-holiday composition stays duplicated in getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange.

placement.why: Holiday matching lives in shared/schedules.ts beside isNonWorkingDay and getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

scope.why: Only the holiday match, its call sites and tests change.

maintainability.why: The holiday format is decided in one place; exporting isNonWorkingDay for the two app.ts sites would have finished the job (the new import is also out of alphabetical order).

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks route through isHoliday; isNonWorkingDay was module-private.

disguised_duplication.where: None introduced; the remaining weekend||holiday conditions in server/schedules/app.ts are pre-existing and visible.
